```{r setup, warning=FALSE}
add_xy <- function(dat) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      X = coords[,1],
      Y = coords[,2]
    )
}

extract_covariates <- function(dat_sf, covariate_stack) {
  vect_pts <- terra::vect(dat_sf)
  cov_vals <- terra::extract(covariate_stack, vect_pts)

  bind_cols(
    dat_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
    cov_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(geometry = st_geometry(dat_sf)) %>%
    st_as_sf()
}

soil_SP_cov <- soil_prop_SP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

soil_COMP_cov <- soil_prop_COMP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)
```

```{r model, warning=FALSE}
coords_SP <- st_coordinates(soil_prop_SP)
coords_COMP <- st_coordinates(soil_prop_COMP)

cutoff_SP <- max(dist(coords_SP)) / 2
cutoff_COMP <- max(dist(coords_COMP)) / 2

width_SP <- 100
width_COMP <- 100

make_resamples <- function(sf_data, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260326) {
  ids <- seq_len(nrow(sf_data))
  seeds <- base_seed + seq_len(n_iter)

  resamples <- vector("list", n_iter)

  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    set.seed(seeds[i])

    n_train <- floor(train_frac * length(ids))
    train_ids <- sort(sample(ids, size = n_train, replace = FALSE))
    test_ids <- setdiff(ids, train_ids)

    resamples[[i]] <- list(
      iteration = i,
      seed = seeds[i],
      train_ids = train_ids,
      test_ids = test_ids
    )
  }

  resamples
}


resamples_SP <- make_resamples(soil_SP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260326)
resamples_COMP <- make_resamples(soil_COMP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20261326)

calc_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(
    n = length(obs),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    mean_error = mean(obs - pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tune_rf_oob <- function(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  x_train <- train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors))
  y_train <- train_df[[response]]

  p <- length(predictors)
  mtry_grid <- unique(pmax(1, c(
    floor(sqrt(p)),
    floor(p / 4),
    floor(p / 3),
    floor(p / 2)
  )))

  fits <- purrr::map(mtry_grid, function(m) {
    set.seed(sample.int(1e6, 1))
    rf <- randomForest(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      ntree = ntree,
      mtry = m,
      importance = TRUE
    )

    tibble(
      mtry = m,
      oob_mse = tail(rf$mse, 1)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  best_mtry <- fits %>%
    slice_min(oob_mse, n = 1) %>%
    pull(mtry)

  list(
    best_mtry = best_mtry,
    tuning_table = fits
  )
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)

  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3

  candidate_models <- c("Sph", "Exp")

  fits <- purrr::map(candidate_models, function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(
          psill = init_psill,
          model = m,
          range = init_range,
          nugget = init_nugget
        )
      )

      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill))) return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0)) return(NULL)

      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)

  sse <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  fits[[which.min(sse)]]
}

run_rf_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)

  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  preds <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  mets <- calc_metrics(test_df[[response]], preds)

  list(
    model = rf_fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = test_df[[response]], pred = preds),
    metrics = mets,
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    tuning_table = tuning$tuning_table
  )
}

run_ok_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff, width) {
  train_sp <- as(train_sf, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf, "Spatial")

  f <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  vg <- variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit <- fit_variogram_models(vg)

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  kr <- krige(f, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit)
  pred <- kr$var1.pred

  obs <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pull(.data[[response]])
  mets <- calc_metrics(obs, pred)

  list(
    variogram = vg,
    fit = fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics = mets
  )
}
run_rk_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  # keep matched sf rows
  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))
  test_sf2  <- test_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))

  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)

  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  trend_train <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  trend_test  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))

  train_sf2$residual <- train_df[[response]] - trend_train

  train_sp <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf2, "Spatial")

  vg_resid <- variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)

  if (is.null(fit_resid)) {
    # fallback to trend-only
    pred <- trend_test
    obs <- test_df[[response]]

    return(list(
      rf_model = rf_fit,
      residual_variogram = vg_resid,
      residual_fit = NULL,
      predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
      metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
      best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
      used_residual_kriging = FALSE
    ))
  }

  kr_resid <- krige(residual ~ 1, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit_resid)
  pred <- trend_test + kr_resid$var1.pred
  obs <- test_df[[response]]

  list(
    rf_model = rf_fit,
    residual_variogram = vg_resid,
    residual_fit = fit_resid,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    used_residual_kriging = TRUE
  )
}


run_one_iteration <- function(sf_data, split, response, predictors, dataset_name, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  test_sf  <- sf_data[split$test_ids, ]

  rf_res <- run_rf_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)
  ok_res <- run_ok_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  rk_res <- run_rk_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff = cutoff, width = width, ntree = ntree)

  bind_rows(
    rf_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RF",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rf_res$best_mtry
      ),

    if (!is.null(ok_res)) {
      ok_res$metrics %>%
        mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          variable = response,
          method = "OK",
          iteration = split$iteration,
          seed = split$seed,
          best_mtry = NA_real_
        )
    },

    rk_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RK",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rk_res$best_mtry,
        used_residual_kriging = rk_res$used_residual_kriging
      )
  )
}
```

```{r ensemble, warning=FALSE}
#ensemble mapping:
select_best_iterations <- function(results_tbl, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5) {
  
  results_tbl %>%
    filter(is.finite(RMSE), is.finite(R2)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      r2_cut   = quantile(R2, probs = 1 - top_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse_cut = quantile(RMSE, probs = top_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = R2 >= r2_cut & RMSE <= rmse_cut
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rmse_score = ifelse(
        max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) == min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - RMSE) /
          (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      r2_score = ifelse(
        max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) == min(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (R2 - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE)) /
          (max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      score = 0.5 * rmse_score + 0.5 * r2_score
    ) %>%
    arrange(dataset, variable, method, desc(score)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = ifelse(sum(keep, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & row_number() <= n_fallback, TRUE, keep)
    ) %>%
    filter(keep) %>%
    mutate(
      weight = score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

selected_iters <- select_best_iterations(results_all, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5)

get_dataset_objects <- function(dataset_name) {
  if (dataset_name == "SP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_SP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_SP,
      cutoff = cutoff_SP,
      width = width_SP
    )
  } else if (dataset_name == "COMP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_COMP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_COMP,
      cutoff = cutoff_COMP,
      width = width_COMP
    )
  } else {
    stop("dataset_name must be 'SP' or 'COMP'")
  }
}

covariates_use <- cov_names
template_rast <- covariate_stack[[1]]

weighted_sd_rasters <- function(rast_stack, weights) {
  w <- weights / sum(weights)
  mu <- sum(rast_stack * w)
  var_r <- sum(((rast_stack - mu)^2) * w)
  sqrt(var_r)
}

build_one_prediction <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, iter_row,
                                 covariates_use, covariate_stack) {
  
  objs <- get_dataset_objects(dataset_name)
  sf_data <- objs$sf_data
  resamples <- objs$resamples
  cutoff <- objs$cutoff
  width <- objs$width
  
  split <- resamples[[iter_row$iteration]]
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  
  # keep only complete cases for the modeled variable + predictors
  train_df <- train_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(variable_name, covariates_use))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(train_df) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(variable_name, covariates_use))))))
  
  if (nrow(train_sf2) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # RF
  if (method_name == "RF") {
    set.seed(iter_row$seed)
    
    mtry_use <- iter_row$best_mtry
    if (!is.finite(mtry_use)) {
      mtry_use <- max(1, floor(sqrt(length(covariates_use))))
    }
    
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
      y = train_df[[variable_name]],
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = mtry_use,
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    r_pred <- terra::predict(
      covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
      rf_model,
      fun = function(model, data) {
        data <- as.data.frame(data)
        predict(model, newdata = data)
      },
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    return(r_pred)
  }
  
  # OK
  if (method_name == "OK") {
    vals <- train_sf2[[variable_name]]
    if (length(unique(vals)) <= 1) return(NULL)
    
    train_sp <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
    f <- as.formula(paste(variable_name, "~ 1"))
    
    vg <- tryCatch(
      variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(vg)) return(NULL)
    
    fit <- fit_variogram_models(vg)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    
    grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
    grid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
    
    ok_pred <- tryCatch(
      krige(f, train_sp, as(grid_sf, "Spatial"), model = fit),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(ok_pred)) return(NULL)
    
    pred_vect <- terra::vect(ok_pred)
    r_pred <- terra::rasterize(pred_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
    return(r_pred)
  }
  
  # RK = RF trend + kriged residuals
  if (method_name == "RK") {
    set.seed(iter_row$seed)
    
    mtry_use <- iter_row$best_mtry
    if (!is.finite(mtry_use)) {
      mtry_use <- max(1, floor(sqrt(length(covariates_use))))
    }
    
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
      y = train_df[[variable_name]],
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = mtry_use,
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    trend_train <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE])
    residuals_train <- train_df[[variable_name]] - trend_train
    
    trend_rast <- terra::predict(
      covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
      rf_model,
      fun = function(model, data) {
        data <- as.data.frame(data)
        predict(model, newdata = data)
      },
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    if (isTRUE(iter_row$used_residual_kriging)) {
      train_res_sf <- train_sf2 %>% mutate(residual = residuals_train)
      train_res_sp <- as(train_res_sf, "Spatial")
      
      vg_resid <- tryCatch(
        variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_res_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (!is.null(vg_resid)) {
        fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)
        
        if (!is.null(fit_resid)) {
          grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
          grid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
          
          rk_resid <- tryCatch(
            krige(residual ~ 1, train_res_sp, as(grid_sf, "Spatial"), model = fit_resid),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          
          if (!is.null(rk_resid)) {
            resid_vect <- terra::vect(rk_resid)
            resid_rast <- terra::rasterize(resid_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
            return(trend_rast + resid_rast)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # fallback: trend-only
    return(trend_rast)
  }
  
  NULL
}

build_final_method_ensemble <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name,
                                        selected_iters, covariates_use, covariate_stack) {
  
  sel <- selected_iters %>%
    filter(
      dataset == dataset_name,
      method == method_name,
      variable == variable_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(weight))
  
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  member_rasters <- list()
  member_weights <- c()
  member_meta <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sel))) {
    r_pred <- build_one_prediction(
      dataset_name = dataset_name,
      method_name = method_name,
      variable_name = variable_name,
      iter_row = sel[i, ],
      covariates_use = covariates_use,
      covariate_stack = covariate_stack
    )
    
    if (!is.null(r_pred)) {
      member_rasters[[length(member_rasters) + 1]] <- r_pred
      member_weights <- c(member_weights, sel$weight[i])
      member_meta[[length(member_meta) + 1]] <- sel[i, ]
    }
  }
  
  if (length(member_rasters) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  rast_stack <- rast(member_rasters)
  member_weights <- member_weights / sum(member_weights)
  
  ens_mean <- sum(rast_stack * member_weights)
  ens_sd <- weighted_sd_rasters(rast_stack, member_weights)
  
  names(ens_mean) <- paste(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, "ensemble_mean", sep = "_")
  names(ens_sd)   <- paste(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, "ensemble_sd", sep = "_")
  
  list(
    mean = ens_mean,
    sd = ens_sd,
    members = rast_stack,
    weights = member_weights,
    selected_rows = bind_rows(member_meta)
  )
}

final_ensemble_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- list()
    
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      cat("Building final ensemble:", ds, meth, v, "\n")
      
      final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- build_final_method_ensemble(
        dataset_name = ds,
        method_name = meth,
        variable_name = v,
        selected_iters = selected_iters,
        covariates_use = covariates_use,
        covariate_stack = covariate_stack
      )
    }
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

for (ds in names(final_ensemble_rasters)) {
  for (meth in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]])) {
    for (v in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]])) {
      obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
      if (!is.null(obj)) {
```

```{r comparison}

#not ensemble: original repeated resampling results in results_all:
    # one row per iteration × dataset × nutrient × method
    # metric computed on the held-out test set for that iteration
    # 
    # Then the p-tests compare those per-iteration metrics in a paired way.


compare_methods_paired <- function(results_tbl, metric = "RMSE") {
  
  method_pairs <- list(
    c("RF", "OK"),
    c("RK", "RF"),
    c("RK", "OK")
  )
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in unique(results_tbl$dataset)) {
    for (v in unique(results_tbl$variable)) {
      
      sub <- results_tbl %>%
        filter(dataset == ds, variable == v) %>%
        select(iteration, method, all_of(metric)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = all_of(metric))
      
      for (pair in method_pairs) {
        m1 <- pair[1]
        m2 <- pair[2]
        
        if (all(c(m1, m2) %in% names(sub))) {
          dat <- sub %>%
            select(iteration, all_of(c(m1, m2))) %>%
            drop_na()
          
          if (nrow(dat) >= 3) {
            test <- wilcox.test(dat[[m1]], dat[[m2]], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
            
            out[[k]] <- tibble(
              dataset = ds,
              variable = v,
              comparison = paste0(m1, "_vs_", m2),
              metric = metric,
              n_pairs = nrow(dat),
              median_diff = median(dat[[m1]] - dat[[m2]], na.rm = TRUE),
              p_value = test$p.value
            )
            k <- k + 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

rmse_tests <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "RMSE")
mae_tests  <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "MAE")
r2_tests   <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "R2")

method_p_tests <- bind_rows(rmse_tests, mae_tests, r2_tests)
method_p_tests <- method_p_tests %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

compare_sampling_paired <- function(results_tbl, metric = "RMSE") {
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (m in unique(results_tbl$method)) {
    for (v in unique(results_tbl$variable)) {
      
      sub <- results_tbl %>%
        filter(method == m, variable == v) %>%
        select(iteration, dataset, all_of(metric)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = all_of(metric))
      
      if (all(c("SP", "COMP") %in% names(sub))) {
        dat <- sub %>%
          select(iteration, SP, COMP) %>%
          drop_na()
        
        if (nrow(dat) >= 3) {
          test <- wilcox.test(dat$SP, dat$COMP, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
          
          out[[k]] <- tibble(
            method = m,
            variable = v,
            metric = metric,
            n_pairs = nrow(dat),
            median_diff = median(dat$SP - dat$COMP, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_value = test$p.value
          )
          k <- k + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

spcomp_rmse_tests <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "RMSE")
spcomp_mae_tests  <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "MAE")
spcomp_r2_tests   <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "R2")

spcomp_p_tests <- bind_rows(spcomp_rmse_tests, spcomp_mae_tests, spcomp_r2_tests) %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

spcomp_p_tests
```

```{r differences}
#analyse the differences in SP and COMP for all variables and methods:



collect_ensemble_means <- function(final_ensemble_rasters) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in names(final_ensemble_rasters)) {
    for (meth in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]])) {
      for (v in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]])) {
        
        obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
        
        if (!is.null(obj) && !is.null(obj$mean)) {
          out[[k]] <- tibble(
            dataset = ds,
            method = meth,
            variable = v,
            raster = list(obj$mean),
            sd_raster = list(obj$sd)
          )
          k <- k + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

ensemble_tbl <- collect_ensemble_means(final_ensemble_rasters)
ensemble_tbl

summarize_raster <- function(r) {
  vals <- terra::values(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  
  tibble(
    mean = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    cv = ifelse(mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE) == 0, NA_real_, sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

ensemble_summary <- ensemble_tbl %>%
  mutate(stats = map(raster, summarize_raster)) %>%
  unnest(stats)

ensemble_summary

make_sp_comp_diffs <- function(ensemble_tbl) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  vars <- sort(unique(ensemble_tbl$variable))
  meths <- sort(unique(ensemble_tbl$method))
  
  for (v in vars) {
    for (m in meths) {
      sp_row <- ensemble_tbl %>% filter(dataset == "SP", method == m, variable == v)
      comp_row <- ensemble_tbl %>% filter(dataset == "COMP", method == m, variable == v)
      
      if (nrow(sp_row) == 1 && nrow(comp_row) == 1) {
        diff_r <- sp_row$raster[[1]] - comp_row$raster[[1]]
        
        out[[k]] <- tibble(
          comparison = "SP_minus_COMP",
          method = m,
          variable = v,
          raster = list(diff_r)
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

map_correlation <- function(r1, r2) {
  vals <- cbind(terra::values(r1), terra::values(r2))
  vals <- vals[complete.cases(vals), , drop = FALSE]
  
  tibble(
    pearson_r = cor(vals[,1], vals[,2], method = "pearson"),
    spearman_r = cor(vals[,1], vals[,2], method = "spearman")
  )
}

#SP vs COMP:
make_sp_comp_correlations <- function(ensemble_tbl) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  vars <- sort(unique(ensemble_tbl$variable))
  meths <- sort(unique(ensemble_tbl$method))
  
  for (v in vars) {
    for (m in meths) {
      sp_row <- ensemble_tbl %>% filter(dataset == "SP", method == m, variable == v)
      comp_row <- ensemble_tbl %>% filter(dataset == "COMP", method == m, variable == v)
      
      if (nrow(sp_row) == 1 && nrow(comp_row) == 1) {
        cor_tbl <- map_correlation(sp_row$raster[[1]], comp_row$raster[[1]])
        
        out[[k]] <- tibble(
          comparison = "SP_vs_COMP",
          method = m,
          variable = v
        ) %>%
          bind_cols(cor_tbl)
        
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

plot_diff_maps <- function(diff_tbl, title_cols) {
  n_maps <- nrow(diff_tbl)
  ncol_plot <- 3
  nrow_plot <- ceiling(n_maps / ncol_plot)
  
  op <- par(mfrow = c(nrow_plot, ncol_plot))
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_maps)) {
    ttl <- paste(diff_tbl[i, title_cols] %>% as.character(), collapse = " | ")
    plot(diff_tbl$raster[[i]], main = ttl)
  }
  
  par(op)
}

plot_diff_maps_chunked <- function(diff_tbl, title_cols, n_per_page = 9, ncol_plot = 3) {
  idx <- split(seq_len(nrow(diff_tbl)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(diff_tbl)) / n_per_page))
  
  for (ii in idx) {
    sub_tbl <- diff_tbl[ii, ]
    n_maps <- nrow(sub_tbl)
    nrow_plot <- ceiling(n_maps / ncol_plot)
    
    op <- par(mfrow = c(nrow_plot, ncol_plot), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))
    
    for (i in seq_len(n_maps)) {
      ttl <- paste(sub_tbl[i, title_cols] %>% as.character(), collapse = " | ")
      plot(sub_tbl$raster[[i]], main = ttl)
    }
    
    par(op)
  }
}

plot_diff_maps_chunked(sp_comp_diff_tbl, c("method", "variable"))
plot_diff_maps_chunked(method_diff_tbl, c("dataset", "comparison", "variable"))

#comparison results indicate that both sampling strategy and modeling method affect the spatial representation of soil properties, but their influence is nutrient-dependent. The strongest SP-versus-COMP differences occurred for Mg, LBC.1, and LBCeq, particularly under ordinary kriging... compositing may substantially alter the spatial expression of these variables. In contrast, pH and Zn were comparatively stable across sampling methods and model types. Method comparisons showed that RF and RK maps were generally much more similar to one another than either was to OK, indicating that the main methodological contrast is between pure geostatistical interpolation and covariate-assisted prediction. The largest method-based discrepancies occurred for Ca and the lime buffer variables, suggesting that these properties are especially sensitive to whether environmental covariates are incorporated into the modeling framework.
```
